label: Google Antigravity (IDE and 2.0 app)
notes: The Antigravity IDE and the Antigravity 2.0 desktop app read workspace skills from <workspace-root>/.agents/skills/ and global skills from ~/.gemini/config/skills/. SKILL.md needs a description; name is optional and must be lowercase with hyphens (ours is frontend-craft, matching the folder). The Antigravity CLI uses a different global folder: use the antigravity-cli adapter for it.
caveats: Docs were read through a summarizing web fetch, not verbatim; re-check before quoting.
The docs also accept the legacy global folder ~/.gemini/antigravity/skills/ and the legacy workspace folder .agent/skills/; the installer writes only the current paths.
Google's skills codelab says the IDE also picks up ~/.agents/skills/, but the skills docs do not list it, so the installer does not rely on it.
In the IDE, installed skills show in the Customizations menu of the agent side panel; there is no terminal command that lists them.
